answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Issued school bus driver registration with school transport attestation. It requires a registration transport officers renew after route audits, so the grove of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the glacier first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The ripple is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
